Lovepedal Mosferatu is pretty damn cool Thread starter Thread starter Dave Locher Start date Start date May 4, 2019 Dave Locher New member May 4, 2019 #1 So I have been waiting for Lovepedal to put the Kalamazoo on flash sale for months because I saw Billy Duffy call it the best overdrive ever in a video and I really like his playing. So this last time around still no Kalamazoo but the Mosferatu Low Gain was $50. I will try just about any pedal for $50, especially when I know I can get it right back if I'm not thrilled. Well, it is one cool little pedal! I thought it was going to be a fuzz but it really is more of a straight overdrive/distortion pedal. Has a TON of volume on tap and huge low end! Just unlike any pedal I have ever used before. I still have not decided if it is my go-to gain boost pedal but I won't be flipping it anytime soon. It's running neck-and-neck with my Guv'nor clone for the coveted "only pedal in the signal chain" spot.   eclecticsynergy Well-known member May 4, 2019 #2 Re: Lovepedal Mosferatu is pretty damn cool I have an old three-knob Mosferatu and it is super fat. A really cool pedal.   Dave Locher New member May 4, 2019 #3 Re: Lovepedal Mosferatu is pretty damn cool Super duper fat!   You must log in or register to reply here. sources.title: Perf and PCB Effects Layouts: Hermida/Lovepedal Mosferatu (3-knob)
sources.excerpt: Perf and PCB Effects Layouts: Hermida/Lovepedal Mosferatu (3-knob) This is a library of perfboard and single-sided PCB effect layouts for guitar and bass. I'm not an electrical engineer by any stretch of the imagination, just a DIY'er who likes drawing layouts. It is meant for the hobbyist (so commercial use of any of these layout is not allowed without permission) and as a way to give back to the online DIY community. Pages Home Store FAQs General Layout Notes PCB Etching Transfer Image Library Drilling Templates Projects YouTube Instagram Facebook OshPark Tuesday, July 23, 2019 Hermida/Lovepedal Mosferatu (3-knob) Came across the schematic ( here on FSB) for this and thought I'd lay it out. Essentially a Son of Screamer but with MOSFETs and germanium diodes for clippers, a modified gain control and a few value tweaks. FYI, the transfer pdf is in the Lovepedal folder, and use the AMZ Son of Screamer drill template. at 9:30 AM Email This BlogThis!
